The opportunity Help people find a cleaner they can rely on, and get rewarded for it. Our Partner community brings people together with trusted professionals. Your job is simple: connect people with the services they need, and earn when they book. Home cleaning Regular Standard Cleaning for busy households across London. Deep cleaning A thorough one-off or seasonal clean for homes and rentals. Property maintenance Repairs and upkeep by trained handymen. No Partner reward on these bookings for now. Business cleaning Offices, shops and short lets that need regular cleaning on a 12-month agreement.

Who can become a Partner Whoever you are, there is a place for you. You do not need experience. You need people who trust your recommendation. You must be 18 or over, live in the UK and have an email address that you control. Digital marketers and content creators. Turn your audience and reach into rewards. Stay-at-home mums and dads. Earn around your day by sharing something useful with people you already know. Freelancers and the self-employed. Add another income stream that fits around your clients. Cleaners who are asked for recommendations every week. Anyone looking for another way to earn. Just your network and a willingness to spread the word.

What you can earn Simple rewards. No fees. No hidden catches. Two ways to earn, one rule: you are rewarded when the people you introduce actually book. Never for recruiting other Partners. £0 To join No joining fee and no monthly fee. You never have to buy anything. £10 For every new household Paid as £5 after their first booking and £5 after their second. Your friend gets £10 off too. 5% to 10% For every new business Of the business's first month's fee: 5% for your first three, then 10% from the fourth. Households Businesses Your reward £10 per new household, in two parts of £5 5% of the first month's fee for your first three, 10% from the fourth What the new customer gets £10 off, as £5 off their first and £5 off their second booking Our cleaning service on a 12-month agreement When it counts After each booking is completed and paid After the 4-week trial ends and the first month's fee is paid How often Once per household Once per business, not again on renewal How you receive it A digital gift card, monthly in arrears. Not paid in cash. The legal bit. Partner rewards apply to cleaning bookings and cleaning agreements only. They are not paid on handyman or property maintenance bookings. New customers and new businesses only. The first month's fee is the amount invoiced for the first month, before VAT, and excludes tips, one-off add-ons, product charges, credits and discounts. We decide whether to accept each business. Partner rewards are given as gift cards after the customer has paid and, for businesses, after the 4-week trial period has ended. If you are already a customer and have not registered as a Partner, your £10 comes as Booking Credit for your next booking. Terms apply.

Earnings calculator See how the numbers add up. Move the sliders to match who you could introduce. The figures follow our Partner Programme Terms exactly. They are illustrations, not a forecast of what you will earn. Illustration only. These examples are not typical or average earnings, and results depend on who you share with and how many of them book. Business rewards are paid only after the business's 4-week trial has ended and its first month's fee has been paid in cleared funds. If a payment is refunded or charged back, we may withhold the reward. You are responsible for declaring any income to HMRC.

How it works Three steps to your first reward. 1 Register your interest It is free and takes less than a minute. 2 We welcome you We explain how it works and give you your personal link, guidance and ready-made messages. 3 Share and earn Tell friends, family, neighbours, followers or local businesses. When they book, you are rewarded. What happens with a business referral You introduceUsing your link, code or referral form, before we have spoken to them. We acceptWe decide whether to take on each business. 12-month agreementThe business signs a written agreement. 4-week trialThe trial ends without either side ending the agreement. You are rewardedThe first month's fee is paid and your reward is counted.

Recommend with confidence Put your name behind professionals you can trust. When you recommend Opulence Bliss, you are introducing people to professionals we have checked, not strangers. Referring should never feel risky. Checked before the first booking Every cleaner goes through identity and right-to-work checks and must show us a basic DBS check before they take bookings. Their own insurance Cleaners hold their own public liability insurance, and we ask to see proof. We handle problems If a visit is not carried out with reasonable care and skill, we arrange a re-clean or refund the affected part, so your friend is looked after.

Share it your way There is no script and there are no set hours. Friends and family A simple conversation can go a long way. Neighbours and local groups Recommend us to people nearby who need help. Social media and your channels Share a link with your followers, subscribers or readers. Local businesses Introduce us to offices, landlords, lettings agents and hosts who need regular cleaning. A ready-made message you can send Hi, I recommend Opulence Bliss for cleaning in London. Easy to book and the cleaners are checked. If you book with my link you get £10 off your first two bookings (£5 each) and I get a thank-you too. Copy message Tell people you are rewarded If you are rewarded for a recommendation, say so. If you post online, label it clearly, for example "ad" or "paid partnership". It keeps your recommendation honest and follows advertising rules. Never promise prices, services or terms for us. Rewards come only from customers and businesses who book, never from recruiting other Partners.

More than extra income The people you recommend keep being rewarded. Your friends do not just get a welcome offer. Loyal customers are rewarded for staying, which makes your recommendation easier to make. 2 hrs free Standard cleaning after 10 completed bookings within 12 months. 5% off Every booking from the 11th booking onwards. Only completed, paid bookings count, and the 10 bookings must be completed within 12 calendar months. The 2 free hours are for standard cleaning and must be used within 6 months. They can add extra hours at our usual rate on top. If the 10 bookings are not completed within 12 calendar months, the count restarts from the customer's next booking. The 5% applies to the booking price only, not to tips or the £5 products add-on, and cannot be combined with other offers apart from the referral discount. Terms apply.

How you are paid Gift cards, every month. We convert your rewards into a digital gift card of your choice and email it to you, monthly in arrears. We pay the cost of issuing it, so you receive the full value. Amazon Tesco Asda Marks & Spencer Good to know Rewards are not paid in cash. If your rewards in a month are too small to issue as a gift card, we add them to the next month. You are responsible for your own tax. We do not deduct tax or National Insurance. Amazon, Tesco, Asda and Marks & Spencer are not connected with Opulence Bliss and do not sponsor or endorse this programme. The retailer's own gift card terms apply, including any expiry date.

Your questions answered Everything you need to know before you join. Is it really free to join? Yes. There is no joining fee and no monthly fee. You do not have to buy anything. Am I an employee of Opulence Bliss? No. Partners are independent. You choose when and how you share, and you are responsible for declaring any income to HMRC. Check gov.uk for the current rules. How and when do I receive my reward? Rewards are given as digital gift cards from Amazon, Tesco, Asda or Marks & Spencer, monthly in arrears, once the customer has paid for the booking or the first month's fee. For businesses, the 4-week trial must also have ended. Rewards are not paid in cash. What counts as a business referral? A business that is new to us and signs a minimum 12-month cleaning agreement with Opulence Bliss. We decide whether to accept each business. Do I earn if I recruit other Partners? No. Rewards are paid only for customers and businesses who actually buy our services, never for recruiting other people. I am already a customer. Can I take part? Yes. If you refer a friend, you receive your £10 as credit towards your next booking. You can also register as a Partner to receive gift cards instead. Can I refer myself or someone in my household? No. We do not pay a reward if we reasonably believe the referral is not genuine, for example where you are the customer or live in the same household. Do I earn when someone books a handyman or property maintenance job? Not at the moment. Partner rewards currently apply to cleaning only. Are cleaners included? Cleaners have their own reward scheme, including rewards for referring other cleaners. Visit the cleaner page to find out more.
